rows.selection: Greenwell Gypsy to win the 10:14 at Dunstall Park
rows.text: Closing my greyhound book for the night is Greenwell Gypsy in Dunstall Park's 10:14. Late-race pace and reliable trapping are the traits I am banking on as the meeting winds down and the class thins around the card's finale. The GBGB page linked on our row confirms the meeting itself; for anything finer-grained readers will need the racecard that withheld itself from me today. Selection: Greenwell Gypsy to win the race.

facts.text: GBGB's official racing page carries Dunstall Park race reports for this week's Scurry Gold Cup and Oaks cards (22 Oct).
